summary: Iteration 12 (backend only): Sign in with Apple (POST /api/auth/apple) + Delete account (DELETE /api/auth/account). New test_iteration12.py adds 23 tests covering the full spec: negative live-server tests (missing/empty/malformed/random-junk identity_token -> 400/401/422), in-process cache-patched verifier tests (wrong kid -> 401 'Unknown Apple signing key'; wrong audience -> 401 'Invalid audience'; kid match + wrong RSA key -> 401 'Invalid Apple token'; expired -> 401 'Apple token expired'), happy path via httpx ASGITransport (first sign-in creates user with apple_sub + returns SessionResponse starting with 'apl_'; second call with null name/email preserves original name/email — never overwrites — DB row verified via pymongo), DELETE /api/auth/account (401 without Bearer; seeded user with rows across users/user_sessions/expenses/friends/groups/settlements/recurring -> DELETE returns {ok:true,deleted:true} and 0 rows remain across every collection; subsequent /api/auth/me with same token -> 401), and full regression (auth/me, root='Montra API', expenses, friends, groups, settlements, recurring, fx snapshot shape, insights, trends, scan 413, CORS preflight). Result: 23/23 iter12 tests + 148/148 full backend suite (`pytest -n 0`, 199.23s) — 100% pass.
action_items: None blocking. Frontend was not in scope; when iter13/UI review runs, exercise the Login 'Continue with Apple' button (iOS-only) and Profile 'Delete account' confirm flow end-to-end.
Carry-over: server.py is now 1082 lines — router split still outstanding.
Carry-over: _SCAN_HITS rate-limit bucket remains per-process in-memory; move to Redis/Mongo TTL for horizontal scale.
Carry-over: currency whitelist duplicated across /expenses, /recurring, /auth/currency — extract helper.

Note: /api/auth/apple with completely missing 'identity_token' field returns Pydantic 422 (not 400). Server also raises 400 when identity_token=='' via _verify_apple_token. Both are acceptable — test accepts (400, 401, 422).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:290-303 _fetch_apple_jwks: correct 1-hour TTL, single-flight via asyncio.Lock, cache mutation only on successful fetch. Good.

server.py:306-339 _verify_apple_token: correctly returns 400 for empty token, 401 for bad header/kid/unknown-kid/invalid-audience/invalid-issuer/expired/generic-invalid, and requires 'sub' claim. Uses pyjwt.decode with audience=list which lets pyjwt accept ANY matching aud in the list — matches Apple multi-audience story (Expo Go vs native bundle).

server.py:342-395 auth_apple: upserts by apple_sub; back-links an existing email-only account when Apple provides an email (rare path — Apple only sends email on first sign-in); crucially the 'do NOT overwrite with nulls' guard only sets name/email when the existing doc is missing them AND the payload has a truthy value. Test verified this behavior.

server.py:399-410 delete_account: hard-deletes across expenses/friends/groups/recurring/settlements/user_sessions/users. No transaction — acceptable for MongoDB single-user cascade. Tokens are invalidated because user_sessions rows are gone (get_current_user 401s on missing session).
server.py:1047 unique+sparse index on apple_sub confirmed on startup — prevents duplicate Apple accounts under the same sub.

AppleSignInRequest declares identity_token as required, so missing field yields Pydantic 422 rather than 400. Not a bug but slightly inconsistent with the empty-string branch which returns 400. Optional: make identity_token Optional[str] and rely on the explicit 400 for empty/missing to unify status codes.

SessionResponse token for Apple flow uses `f'apl_' + uuid.uuid4().hex*2` (64 hex chars, ~256 bits) — sufficient entropy; distinct prefix vs Google session tokens (which are pass-through from Emergent).
seed_data_creation: Reused seed user_test_fixture01 / test_token_abc (conftest.py). TestAppleHappyPathInProc creates a Mongo user with apple_sub='apl_test_<hex>' and cleans it up in the cleanup_apple_users fixture teardown (also nukes all owned rows across expenses/friends/groups/recurring/settlements/user_sessions). TestDeleteAccount seeds an ephemeral user_test_del_<hex> plus one row in each of expenses/friends/groups/settlements/recurring/user_sessions and asserts count==0 across all after DELETE. No seed data leaks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter12 tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py. Apple happy-path & wrong-kid/wrong-aud/wrong-key/expired tests run IN-PROCESS via TestClient + httpx.AsyncClient(ASGITransport) because they must monkey-patch server._APPLE_JWKS_CACHE (unreachable in the separate supervisor-managed live server process). Negative live-server tests (missing/empty/malformed token) run against BASE_URL. If iter13 changes _APPLE_JWKS_CACHE shape or the audience env var name, update _fetch_apple_jwks patch fixture (patched_jwks) accordingly. Key gotcha: motor's AsyncIOMotorClient at server.py:46 is bound at import to the loop of first use; TestClient spins a fresh anyio-portal loop per request causing 'Event loop is closed' — happy-path avoids this by running its own asyncio.new_event_loop().run_until_complete() with httpx.AsyncClient ASGITransport AND rebinding server.client/db to a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient inside that loop. Restored to originals in finally. TestDeleteAccount goes through the LIVE server (real HTTPS ingress) because it doesn't need JWKS patching. Test credentials continue to reuse Bearer test_token_abc.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only test-infra hurdle encountered was motor+TestClient event-loop-closed; documented above and worked around by using httpx ASGITransport with a manually-driven loop + rebinding server.client/db inside the test. Live-server DELETE tests are unaffected.
